about: Every assumption behind a number we calculate (REVAMP §4). Each one is labeled "sourced" (with a url) or "judgment" (with a rationale). The Math page lists all of them. Validated by test/data/provenance.test.ts.

assumptions.label: Share of a Springfield-dependent option's yearly money that counts toward the gap
assumptions.rationale: Partial credit for options that need a state law (v1.1 SPEC §13, kept in v2). The rest is shown as pending Springfield. A game-design scaling factor, not a budget figure: it scales a real report figure and asserts no new number.

assumptions.label: Years over which a ten-year present-value figure (an asset sale) is spread on the scoreboard
assumptions.rationale: Steffany's decision (2026-10-29): spread ten_year_pv figures the way v1 did, figure ÷ 10 per year, still labeled one-time money (an asset sale), not recurring. Matches the data's own annual_equivalent_rule (ten_year_* ÷ 10). Scales a real report figure; asserts no new number.
